item.title: How Haryana’s village health centres are screening heart patients and helping save lives
item.description: A tele-ECG project implemented by the government in partnership with a startup has made ECGs available at primary and community health centres across Haryana. Patients can now get an ECG done, take emergency medication where required, and then be referred to tertiary care centres for procedures

item.title: Who are Sukhbir Singh Sandhu & Vivek Joshi? The 2 election commissioners behind the ECI dissent
item.description: An investive media report has revealed an unprecedented rift within the Election Commission of India. Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi formally objected at least 14 times in 10 months to key decisions made without their approval, covering voter additions, deletions, and database centralisation. This video breaks down who the two officers are and how their objections triggered a political showdown.
